messages.author: b82af643aafe86d2
messages.subject: Ordering facets?
parts:
I think I get the idea, but I can't seem to make this work. My data set
is large and my time is short (a few hours or less), so I hope someone has
a tip based on a description. If necessary, I will try to generate an
example.

I have a dataframe in long format with US state abbreviations, data to
plot, year (almost a 50-year span), and measurement type. I'm plotting
facet-wrapped graphs of data as a function of year for one specific
measurement type, with each facet containing the result for a specific
state.

In other words, the data structure looks sort of like

datum1 + datum2 + datum3 ~ year + state + type

if I remember ddply notation properly.

(I actually have several such graphs to produce, each plotting a different
data column.)

Instead of ordering facets based on alphabetical order of state
abbreviations, I'd like to order them based on a descending value of the
selected data column in a particular year.

The command to produce alphabetized plots looks something like

ggplot(dataframe,
aes(x=Year,y=datacolumnname))+
facet_wrap(~ StateAbbrev)+
expand_limits(y=0)+
geom_line()+
scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1960,1980,2000))+
scale_y_continuous("Data Column Name")

What do I change to sort by descending value of the data in a certain
year? I know it has to do with reordering the StateAbbrev factor somehow.

Thanks,

Bill

messages.subject: Re: Ordering facets?
parts:
(oops only sent it to the author)

This is a sketch of what I'd do, if i understand you correctly.

frame=data.frame(states=c('a','b','c'),value=c(8, 10, 9))
levels=frame$states[sort(frame$value,index.return=TRUE,decreasing=TRUE)$ix]
frame$state.by.value=factor(frame$state,levels=levels)
frame$state.by.value

messages.subject: Re: Ordering facets?
parts:
Does this help?

n <- 5

df <- data.frame(
  x = rnorm(3*n),
  y = rnorm(3*n),
  c = factor(
    rep(c('a','b','c'), each = n), 
    levels = c('a','b','c')
  )
)

ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y), data = df) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(facets = c ~ .)
  
  
df$c <- factor(df$c, levels = c('a','c','b'))

ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y), data = df) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(facets = c ~ .)

david.
